info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to update various attributes of wholesale trading models identified by specific parameters. It enables businesses to modify trading configurations dynamically, ensuring they align with current operational needs. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and trading firms looking to enhance their trading strategies. Utilizing this endpoint, users can easily apply adjustments to existing models to optimize performance and compliance with market changes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific trading model identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: Updates the trading model with the specified ID. This request body should include the details that need to be modified in the trading model, formatted as JSON.
